scenarios.name: Cancel the first save requested while closing a part

scenario_steps.name: the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software
the user creates and finishes an empty sketch on the XY datum plane
the unsaved part containing that sketch is active
save-change prompts are configured to always show
the user closes the document tab
the user chooses Yes in the save-changes prompt
its sketch remains in the model browser
